subject.title: feat(goals): continue active session goals while idle

question: Should OpenClaw change core session goals from non-scheduling session state into an opt-in autonomous continuation runtime, or keep unattended work under Task Flow, tasks, cron, and standing orders?
rationale: Current documentation explicitly separates goals from scheduling, while this PR proposes a new core gateway scheduler and operator configuration contract; tests cannot resolve that ownership choice.

options.title: Keep the current boundary
options.body: Retain goals as durable session guidance and implement unattended orchestration through an existing task owner.

options.title: Sponsor a core goal driver
options.body: Accept autonomous goal continuation as a core gateway capability and require complete config, lifecycle, compatibility, safety, and live-proof implementation.

options.title: Add only a generic seam
options.body: Expose the minimum lifecycle API needed by a task-owned or external controller without making goals schedule work directly.

recommendation.title: Keep the current boundary
recommendation.body: Retain goals as durable session guidance and implement unattended orchestration through an existing task owner.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged feature established the current goal product and ownership boundary.
